title: tprm_board_slide
description: Output contract of the tprm-slide-generator / pptx-executive-summary-ciso agents (Step 1, extract_pdf.py in the agent). Rendered by functions/delivery/renderers/tprm-board-slide/render.py, which runs the byte-verified generate_radar.py + generate_slide.js. Field names and semantics are taken from the skill's own references/data_schema.md and must not drift: generate_slide.js reads these exact keys. Scores are TPRM 10-scale residuals; slide colour thresholds are red >= 5.5, amber >= 4.0, green < 4.0, while the overall classification uses High >= 7.0 / Medium >= 4.0 (governance/RISK_THRESHOLDS.md).

vendor.description: Vendor name exactly as in the OneTrust assessment; used in the title and header.

report_date.description: Human-readable month + year, e.g. 'February 2026' — rendered in the header subtitle.

date.description: Optional alias accepted by the Function's data quality gate (gates.tprm_board_slide) alongside footer_date / assessment_date.

service_desc.description: One line; shown in the Service & Deployment banner.

overall_risk.description: Severity of the maximum domain score (>= 7.0 High, >= 4.0 Medium, else Low); drives the OVERALL RISK KPI colour.

certifications.description: Joined with ', '; an empty array renders as 'None'.

domain_scores.$comment: Exactly these five keys (DOM_KEYS in generate_radar.py). Maximum residual among the risks mapped to the domain; 1.0 when no risk maps to it. A missing key silently becomes 1.0 in the radar — the Function's data gate rejects a payload with other than 5 numeric scores.

detail.description: Truncated to 80 characters on the slide.

residual.description: Optional echo of score; the Function's data gate checks that the list is ordered by descending residual.

top_risks.$comment: Sorted by score descending; the slide renders at most three.

label.description: Short label (Net, IAM, Incidents, Sec risks, Assets, Supply, BC/DR).

mitigations.$comment: First three rendered; any status other than 'Pending' renders as done.

perimeter.description: One entry per domain; internal = Euronext-owned controls, external = vendor-side controls. A missing domain defaults to mitigated/no alert.

findings.$comment: Inline **bold** is parsed: the exact word Pending renders red, Implemented green, any other bold text blue.
